text: おとうとと　いっしょに　しょうぶ　したいの！

structure.jp: おとうとと　いっしょに
しょうぶ　したいの！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it. したい = 'I want to do'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: おとうとと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: と after a person plus いっしょに says you do it together with them. おとうとと　いっしょに = 'together with my little brother'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end shows the speaker is explaining herself, in a soft, feminine way. したいの = 'I want to, you see'.
